prompt: I want to work on the buildkit crash-consistency thing in a separate VM so it doesn't disturb what I've got running. Set up a worktree sandbox for it off develop and get an agent going on it. The motive is nexus3-buildkit-poisoned-snapshot-on-vm-death. Don't actually leave it running, just show me the exact commands you'd run in order and what you'd check after each one.
assertions: Uses `herdr worktree create` or `herdr worktree open` rather than `herdr workspace create --cwd`
Reads workspace id and worktree path from the command's JSON output instead of predicting or hardcoding them
Verifies the workspace shows is_linked_worktree=true before proceeding
Recognises that the auto-provision hook binds the sandbox, rather than racing or fighting it
Points the in-guest agent at .groundwork via an absolute host path, not a /workspace-relative one
Brief instructs the agent to install build-essential before building
